confirmed: Requests 1,4,5,6,7,8,9 returned a vector exactly equal to their published MAT x0; every nonempty callback vector is also that x0.
Requests 2 and 3 returned no vector; native x0 receipt is distinct from independently observed solver acceptance.
Seven requests logged rootlp then heuristics and a finite solver-reported bound; request 7 also logged cutgen, all with numnodes=0.
Every native final message attributes termination to MaxTime; every Python slice also published a SCENE_SLICE_END cancel.
The remaining integer indices are exactly the y option-selection block; auxiliary x/rho/J/w were already relaxed in the saved formulation.
inferences_with_limits: numnodes=0 does not imply root LP never completed: seven requests progressed to heuristics with finite internal bounds, and one to cutgen.
The two larger 86k/90k-row requests lack rootlp/finite-bound observations; they may have spent their slice in root work, but root completion is not logged.
Native inner solve wall time dominates this invocation; these nine observations do not establish which matrix family causes that cost or predict a better method.
For requests without a cutgen event, the interval from heuristics to done cannot be allocated to cut generation, further root LP work, or other internal routines.
missing_or_not_certified: No LP iteration trace, root LP status/exit reason, cut counts or detailed time by internal root/cut routine is archived.
Final output lacks lowerbound; finite callback lowerbounds are solver-reported only and are not original-domain L0.
Native relativegap is retained in its own convention; it is not substituted for independent full-input physical energy gap.
MATLAB initial_point.solver_acceptance is explicitly not_independently_observed; the two empty outputs do not prove rejection of x0.
Cancel files prove cooperative stop requests, not their causal effect; solver-reported final stop messages remain MaxTime.
Python verification and MATLAB solve wall intervals overlap across processes and must not be added as disjoint CPU costs.
